notes.title: Spaceman Memories Demo Launch + PC Specs
notes.content:
[h3][b]🗓 Demo Launches on September 19th[/b][/h3][h3]After a lot of focused solo work the first demo of [i]Spaceman Memories[/i] is almost ready. I'm very sorry for the delays throughout September as I had announced previously it would release on the first week of September, don't want to make excuses but I'm a one man team and I've been squashing a lot of bugs that I encountered almost at launch.[/h3][p]If you’re planning to check it out, here are the system requirements for both Windows and SteamOS/Linux so you know what to expect.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Windows system requirements[/b][/h3][p]✅ Minimum Requirements[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: Windows 10 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 / Intel Core i3-9100[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 8 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 6500 XT[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX[/b]: Version 12 (Shader Model 6 required)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔷 Recommended Requirements[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: Windows 11 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-10400[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 16 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX[/b]: Version 12 (Shader Model 6 required)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]SteamOS/Linux Requirements[/b][/h3][p]Spaceman Memories runs very well on Steam Deck. Performance is smooth, and the entire demo is fully playable with a controller. All core features—movement, combat, menus, and dialogue—work seamlessly with gamepad input, making it a great experience in handheld mode or docked.[/p][p]✅ Minimum[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: SteamOS 3.0 / Linux (Arch, Ubuntu 22.04+, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: AMD Zen 2 / AMD Ryzen 3 5300U or Intel Core i5-9400 or better[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 16 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: AMD RDNA2 GPU (Steam Deck) or NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6600[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][p]🔷 Recommended[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: SteamOS 3.0 / Linux (Arch, Ubuntu 22.04+, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: AMD Zen 2 / AMD Ryzen 3 5300U or Intel Core i5-9400 or better[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 16 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: AMD RDNA2 GPU (Steam Deck) or NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6600[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][p]If you’re excited for the demo, [b]wishlist the game[/b]—it helps a lot more than you think.
Thanks for following along, and see you September 1st.[/p]
